description: Sonjapgo connects ChatGPT to your projects, tasks, shared working documents, work reports, and private thought branches. Users can find and continue current work, create projects and tasks, record and complete work, and safely preview, apply, inspect, or restore line-level document changes through authenticated workflows. Sonjapgo keeps project context connected so ChatGPT can work from the latest project, task, document, and report information.

defaultPrompt: Show me my Sonjapgo projects, find my current work, and tell me what I should work on next.
Save my idea as a private thought branch and help me decide whether it should become a project.
Review my project’s current documents, tasks, and recent work reports, then suggest what I should do next.
